articles.title: Indonesia enters pre-production stage for Scorpene Evolved submarine
articles.summary: Indonesian state-owned shipbuilder PT PAL Indonesia confirmed its Scorpene Evolved-class submarine development for the Indonesian Navy has entered the pre-production phase. This project underscores Indonesia's commitment to bolstering naval capabilities and domestic defence production, likely through technology transfer. Such strategic initiatives are crucial for enhancing national self-reliance and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific.

articles.title: NASA dodged Trump's worst cuts. Scientists say what's left is still devastating.
articles.summary: A US congressional panel advanced a spending bill for NASA, rejecting the White House's proposal for a drastic near 50% cut. While averting the larger reduction, the bill still imposes a significant funding cut on the space agency's programs. This development impacts future US space exploration and scientific research initiatives, highlighting budgetary pressures on key scientific institutions.

articles.title: Experts warn Africa risks becoming mere raw data supplier
articles.summary: African stakeholders warn the continent risks becoming merely a raw input supplier in the global Artificial Intelligence economy. Experts from technology, finance, and infrastructure sectors stress the urgent need for strategic investment and policy development. Without proactive measures, Africa may miss capitalizing on AI's transformative potential, hindering its technological self-reliance and global competitiveness.

articles.title: Choose from six nominees for Cellcom Post-Crescent athlete of the week
articles.summary: This article outlines a community poll inviting readers to vote for the 'Cellcom Post-Crescent high school athlete of the week'. Voting is open to all, irrespective of subscription status, until May 30. It focuses on local engagement and recognition of athletic talent within a specific area, highlighting participation in local sports achievements.

articles.title: UPSC Key: Rupee depreciation, Available realised equity and Road dust
articles.summary: This text outlines crucial examination topics, vital for an SSB aspirant's preparation. It emphasizes current events of both national and international importance for preliminary stages. Additionally, for the mains (General Studies II), focus is placed on India's bilateral, regional, and global groupings and agreements. Mastering these areas is key for comprehensive success.

articles.title: Philippine President Marcos to Visit Japan as State Guest
articles.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is undertaking a state visit to Japan, commencing May 26th. This high-level engagement underscores the deep bilateral ties between the two nations, which are crucial for regional stability and economic cooperation. For an SSB aspirant, this highlights the importance of strategic partnerships and diplomatic initiatives in strengthening international relations, especially concerning shared interests like energy security and regional influence.

articles.title: Israeli State Policy, the Infrastructure of Impunity. Criminality and the West’s Complicity
articles.summary: UN Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher, on August 22, 2025, asserted that an ongoing famine was preventable had intervention been permitted. This statement underscores the critical challenges in international humanitarian aid delivery and the complexities of global cooperation in averting such crises. Aspirants should recognize the importance of effective multilateral mechanisms and global political will in addressing food security issues worldwide.

articles.title: Arkansas Teen Sailor Killed At Pearl Harbor Will Finally Be Laid To Rest After Nearly 85 Years
articles.summary: Fireman 3rd Class Ro, an Arkansas teenager killed on a battleship during the 1941 Pearl Harbor attack, is finally returning home for burial after nearly 85 years. The U.S. Navy is facilitating the return of his identified remains, offering closure to his family and community. This event underscores the enduring impact of historical conflicts and the military's commitment to honoring its fallen personnel, even decades later.
